     8→   * for all them. If at least one set is invalid, all sets are reverified individually. For normal network
     9→   * conditions this strategy can yield 50% improvement in CPU time spent verifying gossip objects.
    10→   * Only non-time critical objects should be marked as batchable, since the pool may hold them for 100ms.
    11→   */
    12→  batchable?: boolean;

    15→   * Use main thread to verify signatures, use this with care.
    16→   * Ignore the batchable option if this is true.

    25→export interface IBlsVerifier {

    27→   * Verify 1 or more signature sets. Sets may be verified on batch or not depending on their count
    28→   *
    29→   * Signatures all come from the wire (untrusted) are all bytes compressed, must be:
    30→   * - Parsed from bytes
    31→   * - Uncompressed
    32→   * - subgroup_check
    33→   * - consume in Pairing.aggregate as affine, or mul_n_aggregate as affine
    34→   * Just send the raw signture recevied as bytes to the thread and verify there
    35→   *
    36→   * Pubkeys all come from cache (trusted) have already been checked for subgroup and infinity
    37→   * - Some pubkeys will have to be aggregated, some don't

    39→   * - Then, consume in Pairing.aggregate as affine, or mul_n_aggregate as affine
    40→   *
